body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended): A module modular robotcomprising a plurality of modules that are coupled together, wherein each of the plurality of modules includes:a first link;
a second link movably linked to the first link; and
a fluid liquid pressure cylinder configured to move the first link and the second link relative to each other by a working fluid that is supplied to a cylinder chamber from a liquid pressure source located outside the plurality of modules and is discharged from the cylinder chamber to a tank located outside the plurality of modules, wherein the first link has includes a cylinder block in which [[a]]the cylinder chamber of the fluid liquid pressure cylinder is formed, the cylinder block having a plurality of outer surfaces, and at least two of the plurality of outer surfaces of the cylinder block each have both a pump port connectable to the liquid pressure source and a tank port connectable to the tank.
2. (Currently Amended): The module modular robot according to claim 1, wherein the module robot is configured by coupling a plurality of modules,the modules each has the first link, the second link, and the fluid pressure cylinder, and
two of the plurality of modules includes a first module and a second module that are coupled by connecting the first link or the second link of [[a]]the first module [[with]]to the first link or the second link of [[a]]the second module, the first module being one of the two modules, and the second module being other of the two modules.
3. (Currently Amended): The module modular robot according to claim 2, wherein the cylinder block of the first module is connectable [[with]]to the first link or the second link of the second module.
4. (Currently Amended): The module modular robot according to claim 1, wherein the module robot is configured of a plurality of modules, the modules being formed so as to be arepartially integrated.
